# Sri Ashwini Physiotherapy Clinic

> Sri Ashwini Physiotherapy Clinic is a physiotherapy clinic in Danavaipeta, Rajahmundry, Andhra Pradesh.

## About

Sri Ashwini Physiotherapy Clinic provides physiotherapy care for movement-related conditions, pain management and rehabilitation.

Website: [Sri Ashwini Physiotherapy Clinic](https://sriashwiniphysiotherapyclinic.com/)

## Services

- Electro Therapy
- Manual Therapy
- Cupping Therapy
- Exercise Therapy
- Dry Needling

## Conditions

The clinic provides physiotherapy care related to back pain, neck pain, knee pain, shoulder pain, sports injuries and other movement-related conditions.

## Location

Danavaipeta, Rajahmundry, Andhra Pradesh, India.
